Package uni.insubria.theknife.common.dto

Record Class RestaurantDto

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
uni.insubria.theknife.common.dto.RestaurantDto
Record Components:
id - unique restaurant id (legacy hash for seeded data, UUID for new ones)
name - restaurant name
address - physical address
location - city / locality
price - price band (e.g. "€€")
cuisine - cuisine type(s)
longitude - longitude
latitude - latitude
phone - phone number
michelinUrl - Michelin guide URL
websiteUrl - official website URL
award - Michelin award/recognition
greenStar - number of Michelin green stars
facilities - facilities and services (used by client-side filters)
description - description text
ownerUsername - username of the owning RISTORATORE, or null
reviews - reviews for this restaurant
public record RestaurantDto(String id, String name, String address, String location, String price, String cuisine, Double longitude, Double latitude, String phone, String michelinUrl, String websiteUrl, String award, Integer greenStar, String facilities, String description, String ownerUsername, List<ReviewDto> reviews) extends Record
Wire representation of a restaurant, including its embedded reviews. The owner is referenced by username only (acyclic). This mirrors the in-memory shape the legacy JavaFX client used to load from restaurants.json, so the client model maps to it one-to-one and the existing filtering logic keeps working.
